overworld.name: Scary Dungeon
overworld.description: ok so this is the first one and its a dungeon and its REALLY scary. the walls are all gray and gross and theres bad guys EVERYWHERE.

levels.name: The Entry Hall
levels.description: this is where you go in. its not THAT scary yet but just wait.
levels.theme: gray stone walls, torches on walls, dirt floor

levels.name: Deeper Down
levels.description: now its getting darker and the bad guys are meaner. told you it gets scary.
levels.theme: darker stone, more shadows, cobwebs

levels.name: The Dark Part
levels.description: you cant see ANYTHING its SO dark. the bad guys have glowing eyes though so watch out.
levels.theme: pitch black corridors, glowing eyes in darkness

levels.name: Trap Hallway
levels.description: theres traps ALL over the floor. one wrong step and BOOM youre done.
levels.theme: spike pits, pressure plates, swinging blades

levels.name: The Big Door
levels.description: theres this HUGE door and you need the white square to open it. the boss is behind it.
levels.theme: massive iron door, key pedestal, guard room

levels.name: The Boss Room
levels.description: THIS IS IT. the boss is SO big and SO mean. hes been waiting for you the WHOLE time.
levels.theme: throne room, boss arena, treasure pile

boss.name: Big Mean Circle
boss.description: hes huge and red and when he sees you he goes RAWR SO loud

weapon.name: Pointy Stick
weapon.description: its really sharp and it goes SWOOSH when you swing it

armor.name: Cardboard Shield
armor.description: it doesnt look like much but it blocks stuff pretty good

designs.victory_message: YAY you did it!! the big mean circle is GONE!!
designs.defeat_message: oh no he got you. the dungeon wins this time.

boss.name: Mean Purple Triangle
boss.description: hes purple and pointy and he POKES you really hard

weapon.name: Wooden Sword
weapon.description: it goes CLACK CLACK when you hit stuff

armor.name: Pot Lid
armor.description: its round and shiny and blocks attacks really good

designs.victory_message: you got the purple triangle!! hes not pointy anymore!!
designs.defeat_message: the purple triangle poked you too much. ow ow ow.

boss.name: Shadow Beast
boss.description: you can barely see him but his EYES glow and hes SO fast

weapon.name: Glowing Dagger
weapon.description: it glows in the dark so you can see where youre stabbing

armor.name: Night Cloak
armor.description: it makes you harder to see in the dark

designs.victory_message: the shadow beast is gone and you can see again!!
designs.defeat_message: the darkness swallowed you up. spooky.

boss.name: The Trap Master
boss.description: he BUILT all the traps and he knows where every single one is

weapon.name: Trap Hammer
weapon.description: its really heavy and it smashes traps AND bad guys

armor.name: Iron Boots
armor.description: they protect your feet from all the spiky floor stuff

designs.victory_message: no more traps!! the trap master got trapped by HIS OWN traps!!
designs.defeat_message: you stepped on the wrong thing. OUCH.

boss.name: Gate Guardian
boss.description: hes ENORMOUS and he guards the door and he does NOT let anyone through

weapon.name: Silver Blade
weapon.description: it shines SO bright the bad guys cant even look at it

armor.name: Gate Shield
armor.description: its made of the same stuff as the big door

designs.victory_message: the guardian is down and the big door is OPEN!!
designs.defeat_message: the guardian squished you. he was too strong this time.

boss.name: King Bonecrusher
boss.description: the FINAL boss. hes sitting on a throne made of BONES and he is NOT happy to see you

weapon.name: Hero Sword
weapon.description: THE sword. the one you need to beat the king.

armor.name: Diamond Armor
armor.description: its SO shiny and its the strongest armor in the whole dungeon

designs.victory_message: KING BONECRUSHER IS DONE!! you saved the dungeon!! well you beat it anyway!!
designs.defeat_message: the king bonecrushed you. his name was NOT lying.

overworld.name: Monster Town
overworld.description: the monsters have a whole TOWN. they have houses and everything but theyre all bad and they dont want you there.

levels.name: Monster Suburb
levels.description: the outside part of town. the monsters here arent that tough yet.
levels.theme: monster houses, picket fences, dark yards

levels.name: Main Street
levels.description: this is the big road in the middle and ALL the monsters hang out here.
levels.theme: shops, monster market, lampposts

levels.name: Monster School
levels.description: even the monsters go to school! but they learn how to be MEAN.
levels.theme: desks, chalkboards, monster drawings on walls

levels.name: The Sewers
levels.description: GROSS. under the town is all sewers and the WORST monsters live down here.
levels.theme: pipes, green water, slime walls

levels.name: Town Hall
levels.description: the mayor monster is in here and he has the key to the castle.
levels.theme: big building, monster flag, meeting room

levels.name: Monster Castle
levels.description: the BIGGEST monster lives up here. the whole town is scared of HIM too.
levels.theme: castle walls, drawbridge, monster throne

boss.name: Suburb Boss
boss.description: hes the biggest monster on the block and he has a HUGE lawn

weapon.name: Rake Of Doom
weapon.description: it hurts SO bad to step on it. now YOU get to use it

armor.name: Trash Can Lid
armor.description: its dented but it works

designs.victory_message: the suburb is safe now! no more mean yard dogs!!
designs.defeat_message: the suburb boss sent you home. he was too tough.

boss.name: Market King
boss.description: he runs all the shops and everything costs YOUR health points

weapon.name: Shopping Sword
weapon.description: sharp as a shopping cart wheel

armor.name: Barrel Armor
armor.description: you hid inside a barrel and now its armor

designs.victory_message: main street is yours now!! all the shops are closed though.
designs.defeat_message: the market king beat you at his own game.

boss.name: Principal Meanie
boss.description: hes the worst principal EVER and he gives you detention FOREVER

weapon.name: Ruler Blade
weapon.description: the BIGGEST ruler. it measures AND hurts

armor.name: Textbook Shield
armor.description: its SO thick no attack can get through all those pages

designs.victory_message: school is OUT!! principal meanie got expelled!!
designs.defeat_message: principal meanie sent you to the worst detention.

boss.name: Sewer King
boss.description: hes been down here SO long hes all green and slimy and HUGE

weapon.name: Drain Pipe Club
weapon.description: its heavy and gross but it HITS hard

armor.name: Slime Coat
armor.description: its disgusting but nothing can grab you

designs.victory_message: the sewers are clean! well cleaner. still gross.
designs.defeat_message: the sewer king flushed you. ewwww.

boss.name: Mayor Monster
boss.description: he has a fancy suit and a top hat and he is SUPER mean about rules

weapon.name: Gavel Of Justice
weapon.description: BANG BANG ORDER IN THE COURT then you hit monsters

armor.name: Mayor Sash
armor.description: it says MAYOR but now it says YOUR NAME

designs.victory_message: the mayor is voted OUT!! democracy wins!!
designs.defeat_message: the mayor passed a law that says you lose. thats cheating.

boss.name: Monster King
boss.description: THE KING. hes got a crown and a scepter and FANGS and hes the scariest one in the whole town

weapon.name: Kings Bane
weapon.description: the one weapon the king is actually SCARED of

armor.name: Castle Plate
armor.description: the strongest armor in the whole town

designs.victory_message: THE MONSTER KING IS DONE!! the whole town is free!!
designs.defeat_message: the king won this time. his castle was too strong.

overworld.name: Spooky Forest
overworld.description: its a forest and its REALLY spooky. theres trees everywhere and eyes watching you from the dark. something is moving behind every tree.

levels.name: Forest Edge
levels.description: the trees start here and right away its creepy. you can hear stuff moving.
levels.theme: tall dark trees, fallen leaves, misty ground

levels.name: The Thick Part
levels.description: the trees are SO close together you can barely squeeze through and its SO dark.
levels.theme: dense forest, hanging vines, mushrooms

levels.name: Spider Woods
levels.description: EVERYTHING has webs on it. the spiders here are ENORMOUS and they are NOT friendly.
levels.theme: giant webs, cocoons, sticky ground

levels.name: The Swamp Part
levels.description: the forest gets all swampy and gross and things GRAB you from the water.
levels.theme: murky water, dead trees, bubbling mud

levels.name: Witch Clearing
levels.description: theres a clearing with a creepy house and a witch lives there and she is NOT nice.
levels.theme: witch hut, cauldron, magical circles

levels.name: The Heart Tree
levels.description: in the very MIDDLE of the forest theres this giant evil tree and its ALIVE and its the boss.
levels.theme: massive evil tree, glowing roots, dark hollow

boss.name: Forest Troll
boss.description: hes been hiding under the bridge and he is REALLY grumpy

weapon.name: Branch Blade
weapon.description: its a really strong branch that hits like a REAL sword

armor.name: Bark Shield
armor.description: its made of really thick bark and its super tough

designs.victory_message: the troll went back under his bridge and LEFT!!
designs.defeat_message: the forest troll got you. his bridge won.

boss.name: Vine Horror
boss.description: its ALL vines twisted together into a monster shape and it GRABS you

weapon.name: Vine Cutter
weapon.description: it cuts through vines like BUTTER

armor.name: Leaf Mail
armor.description: all the leaves stuck together into armor somehow

designs.victory_message: the vine horror fell apart!! just a pile of leaves now!!
designs.defeat_message: the vines got you all tangled up. stuck forever.

boss.name: Spider Queen
boss.description: shes got EIGHT eyes and EIGHT legs and shes the size of a CAR

weapon.name: Fang Dagger
weapon.description: its made from a spider fang. gross but SHARP

armor.name: Web Wrap Armor
armor.description: sticky but nothing gets through

designs.victory_message: the spider queen is squished!! no more webs!!
designs.defeat_message: the spider queen wrapped you up for later. uh oh.

boss.name: Swamp Thing
boss.description: it comes OUT of the swamp and its all mud and seaweed and it STINKS

weapon.name: Reed Spear
weapon.description: its long and poky and really good for swamp fights

armor.name: Turtle Shell
armor.description: you found it in the swamp. its really hard

designs.victory_message: the swamp thing sank back into the mud!! SPLOSH!!
designs.defeat_message: the swamp thing pulled you under. blub blub blub.

boss.name: Wicked Witch
boss.description: she throws potions at you and turns things into FROGS and shes SO mean

weapon.name: Anti-Magic Sword
weapon.description: the witch HATES this sword because it blocks all her spells

armor.name: Spell Ward Cloak
armor.description: her magic just bounces RIGHT off

designs.victory_message: the witch flew away on her broom!! BYE BYE WITCH!!
designs.defeat_message: the witch turned you into a frog. ribbit.

boss.name: The Heart Tree
boss.description: its a GIANT evil tree and its roots go EVERYWHERE and it tries to SMASH you

weapon.name: Axe of Ages
weapon.description: the ONLY thing that can chop the heart tree

armor.name: Ancient Bark Mail
armor.description: its from a GOOD tree that wants to help

designs.victory_message: THE HEART TREE IS CHOPPED!! the whole forest is happy now!!
designs.defeat_message: the heart tree got you with its roots. the forest stays evil.

overworld.name: Lava World
overworld.description: EVERYTHING IS LAVA. well not everything but A LOT of it. the orange stuff HURTS if you touch it so watch your step.

levels.name: Lava Fields
levels.description: the ground is all cracked and theres lava coming through the cracks. its SO hot.
levels.theme: cracked earth, lava streams, volcanic rock

levels.name: Fire Caves
levels.description: caves full of FIRE. the walls glow orange and dripping lava is everywhere.
levels.theme: glowing cave walls, stalactites, lava pools

levels.name: The Furnace
levels.description: its like a giant OVEN in here. the bad guys are all made of fire and they dont even care.
levels.theme: metal walls, furnace grates, fire vents

levels.name: Obsidian Maze
levels.description: everything is black and shiny and you get LOST so easy. the reflections trick you.
levels.theme: black glass walls, reflection pools, dark corridors

levels.name: Dragon Nest
levels.description: theres baby dragons EVERYWHERE and their mom is NOT going to be happy you showed up.
levels.theme: nests, eggs, scorched ground, bones

levels.name: The Volcano
levels.description: THE ACTUAL VOLCANO. the final boss lives in the lava and he can SWIM in it.
levels.theme: volcano crater, lava lake, obsidian throne

boss.name: Lava Brute
boss.description: hes made of cooled lava and when he gets mad he starts GLOWING

weapon.name: Obsidian Blade
weapon.description: its black and super sharp and it never gets dull

armor.name: Heat Shield
armor.description: it keeps the fire AWAY from you

designs.victory_message: the lava brute cooled down into a rock!! a boring rock!!
designs.defeat_message: you got too close to the lava. ssssss.

boss.name: Cave Inferno
boss.description: the whole cave is basically ALIVE and on FIRE

weapon.name: Fire Poker
weapon.description: you poke the fire monsters WITH fire. they dont like it

armor.name: Asbestos Cloak
armor.description: fire cant even TOUCH you with this

designs.victory_message: the cave stopped being on fire!! mostly!!
designs.defeat_message: the cave was too hot. you melted. oops.

boss.name: Furnace Golem
boss.description: hes MADE of the furnace. like the whole furnace got up and walked

weapon.name: Cooling Rod
weapon.description: it makes fire monsters go PSSHHHH and steam comes out

armor.name: Forge Plate
armor.description: its been through the fire so many times nothing hurts it

designs.victory_message: the furnace is OFF!! its cooling down finally!!
designs.defeat_message: the furnace golem turned you into a crispy critter.

boss.name: Mirror Demon
boss.description: he looks JUST like you but EVIL and he copies everything you do

weapon.name: True Blade
weapon.description: the only sword that doesnt get confused by the mirrors

armor.name: Crystal Armor
armor.description: you can see the REAL bad guys through it

designs.victory_message: the mirror demon cracked into a million pieces!! bad luck for HIM!!
designs.defeat_message: the mirror demon tricked you. you hit yourself. embarrassing.

boss.name: Mama Dragon
boss.description: shes HUGE and shes protecting her eggs and she breathes ACTUAL fire

weapon.name: Dragon Tooth Sword
weapon.description: its from a dragon that was NICE and wanted to help

armor.name: Dragon Scale Shield
armor.description: dragon scales are the toughest thing EVER

designs.victory_message: mama dragon flew away with her babies!! she was just scared!!
designs.defeat_message: mama dragon breathed fire on you. she was NOT happy.

boss.name: Magma Lord
boss.description: he SWIMS in the lava like its a pool and he throws lava balls at you

weapon.name: Frost Brand
weapon.description: its SO cold it makes the lava HARDEN when you hit it

armor.name: Volcanic Plate
armor.description: forged IN the volcano so the volcano cant hurt you

designs.victory_message: THE MAGMA LORD HARDENED INTO STONE!! the volcano is dormant!!
designs.defeat_message: the magma lord dunked you in lava. its over.

overworld.name: Underwater Place
overworld.description: youre UNDERWATER! you can breathe because you have a special helmet. the fish down here are NOT friendly and some of them have TEETH.

levels.name: Shallow Reef
levels.description: the water isnt that deep yet and theres pretty coral but MEAN fish.
levels.theme: coral reef, colorful fish, sandy bottom

levels.name: The Deep Part
levels.description: now its REALLY deep and dark and the fish down here glow in the dark.
levels.theme: deep ocean, bioluminescent creatures, underwater caves

levels.name: Shipwreck Graveyard
levels.description: theres old ships EVERYWHERE and the ghosts of pirates live in them. GHOST PIRATES.
levels.theme: sunken ships, treasure, ghostly glow

levels.name: Jellyfish Canyon
levels.description: the whole canyon is full of jellyfish and they STING SO BAD. dont touch the glow-y ones.
levels.theme: floating jellyfish, narrow canyon, electric water

levels.name: Mermaid Kingdom
levels.description: theres mermaids but theyre the EVIL kind and they sing songs that hurt your brain.
levels.theme: underwater palace, evil mermaids, enchanted water

levels.name: The Kraken Lair
levels.description: at the VERY bottom of the ocean the kraken lives. it has SO many tentacles and its GIGANTIC.
levels.theme: abyssal trench, massive tentacles, dark water

boss.name: Reef Shark King
boss.description: hes the biggest shark in the reef and he has THREE rows of teeth

weapon.name: Coral Sword
weapon.description: its sharp as coral which is REALLY sharp if you didnt know

armor.name: Shell Armor
armor.description: its all shells stuck together and its really hard

designs.victory_message: the shark king swam away!! the reef is peaceful now!!
designs.defeat_message: the shark king got you. too many teeth.

boss.name: Angler Horror
boss.description: it has a LIGHT on its head to trick you and then CHOMP

weapon.name: Depth Blade
weapon.description: it works even in the deepest darkest water

armor.name: Pressure Suit
armor.description: the deep water cant squish you anymore

designs.victory_message: the angler horror lost its light!! hes just a regular ugly fish now!!
designs.defeat_message: the angler horror tricked you with its light. chomp.

boss.name: Ghost Captain
boss.description: hes the captain of ALL the ghost ships and he can go through walls which is SO unfair

weapon.name: Holy Anchor
weapon.description: its blessed and it can hit ghosts which is the ONLY thing that works

armor.name: Ghost Ward Shield
armor.description: ghosts bounce RIGHT off this

designs.victory_message: the ghost captain finally moved on!! rest in peace captain!!
designs.defeat_message: the ghost captain claimed you for his crew. youre a ghost pirate now.

boss.name: Mega Jelly
boss.description: its the BIGGEST jellyfish and its tentacles are EVERYWHERE and they zap you

weapon.name: Rubber Sword
weapon.description: electricity CANT hurt you through rubber! science!!

armor.name: Rubber Suit
armor.description: now NOTHING can shock you

designs.victory_message: the mega jelly popped!! SPLAT all over the canyon!!
designs.defeat_message: the mega jelly zapped you so hard your hair stands up forever.

boss.name: Siren Queen
boss.description: she sings and the song makes you want to walk into danger. cover your EARS

weapon.name: Silence Blade
weapon.description: it makes everything quiet so the singing stops

armor.name: Earplugs Of Power
armor.description: you cant hear the singing anymore HAHA

designs.victory_message: the siren queen lost her voice!! the kingdom is free!!
designs.defeat_message: the siren queen sang you to sleep. forever sleep. uh oh.

boss.name: The Kraken
boss.description: it has TEN tentacles and EACH one is bigger than you and its been down here for a THOUSAND years

weapon.name: Trident Of The Deep
weapon.description: the ULTIMATE underwater weapon. it goes FSSSSH through water

armor.name: Abyss Plate
armor.description: the deepest armor from the deepest place

designs.victory_message: THE KRAKEN WENT BACK TO SLEEP!! the ocean is safe!!
designs.defeat_message: the kraken grabbed you with ALL its tentacles. squish.

overworld.name: Sky Castle
overworld.description: theres a castle IN THE SKY. you have to climb up clouds to get there. dont look down because its REALLY far.

levels.name: Cloud Steps
levels.description: you climb up these clouds like stairs but some of them DISAPPEAR when you step on them.
levels.theme: fluffy clouds, blue sky, wind gusts

levels.name: Wind Tunnels
levels.description: the wind up here is SO strong it pushes you around and the bad guys FLY.
levels.theme: wind streams, floating platforms, flying enemies

levels.name: Rainbow Bridge
levels.description: theres a rainbow and you can WALK on it but its slippery and the colors change.
levels.theme: rainbow path, prism monsters, color shifts

levels.name: Thunder Hall
levels.description: BOOM BOOM BOOM the thunder is SO loud and lightning hits the floor randomly.
levels.theme: storm clouds, lightning strikes, electrified ground

levels.name: Eagle Nests
levels.description: giant eagles live up here and theyre protective of their babies. DONT touch the eggs.
levels.theme: massive nests, giant feathers, egg chambers

levels.name: The Throne Above
levels.description: the SKY KING sits on a throne made of lightning and he controls ALL the weather.
levels.theme: lightning throne, storm chamber, eye of hurricane

boss.name: Cloud Giant
boss.description: hes made of clouds but he punches like ROCKS. how is that even fair

weapon.name: Wind Blade
weapon.description: it cuts through air and makes a WHOOSH sound

armor.name: Cloud Cloak
armor.description: you float a little bit when you wear it

designs.victory_message: the cloud giant puffed away!! hes just regular clouds now!!
designs.defeat_message: the cloud giant blew you off the edge. wheeeee SPLAT.

boss.name: Storm Hawk
boss.description: its a HUGE hawk and it flaps its wings and the wind knocks you over

weapon.name: Gale Sword
weapon.description: swing it and it makes a tornado. a LITTLE tornado

armor.name: Wind Walker Boots
armor.description: you can walk on air! for a little bit

designs.victory_message: the storm hawk lost its feathers!! its just a chicken now!!
designs.defeat_message: the storm hawk blew you off the sky castle. bye bye.

boss.name: Prism Dragon
boss.description: it changes colors and EACH color does a different attack. SO tricky

weapon.name: Spectrum Blade
weapon.description: it hits with ALL the colors at once

armor.name: Prism Shield
armor.description: it reflects the attacks back at the bad guys

designs.victory_message: the prism dragon turned white!! all the colors left!!
designs.defeat_message: the prism dragon color blasted you. you see rainbows forever.

boss.name: Thunder Titan
boss.description: every step he takes makes THUNDER and he throws LIGHTNING BOLTS

weapon.name: Thunder Hammer
weapon.description: BOOM every time you hit something. SO satisfying

armor.name: Rubber Cloud Armor
armor.description: lightning bounces right off

designs.victory_message: the thunder titan ran out of lightning!! hes just a big guy now!!
designs.defeat_message: the thunder titan zapped you. your hair will NEVER go back to normal.

boss.name: Eagle Empress
boss.description: shes SO big her wings block out the SUN and shes protecting the biggest egg EVER

weapon.name: Talon Blade
weapon.description: its made from a shed eagle talon. sharp as anything

armor.name: Feather Mail
armor.description: light as a feather but strong as iron

designs.victory_message: the eagle empress let you through!! she just wanted to protect her babies!!
designs.defeat_message: the eagle empress picked you up and THREW you. ow.

boss.name: Sky King
boss.description: he sits on a THRONE OF LIGHTNING and he controls EVERY storm EVERYWHERE

weapon.name: Crown Breaker
weapon.description: the only sword strong enough to break the sky kings crown

armor.name: Storm Plate
armor.description: you ARE the storm now. nothing storm-related hurts you

designs.victory_message: THE SKY KING LOST HIS CROWN!! sunny skies forever!!
designs.defeat_message: the sky king struck you with everything. lightning, thunder, rain, hail, ALL of it.

overworld.name: Candy Land
overworld.description: EVERYTHING is candy!! the walls are chocolate and the floor is frosting. but the candy is ALIVE and it wants to eat YOU for a change.

levels.name: Gummy Gardens
levels.description: gummy bears EVERYWHERE and theyre bouncing around trying to squish you.
levels.theme: gummy trees, jelly flower beds, sugar path

levels.name: Chocolate River
levels.description: theres a whole RIVER of chocolate and the chocolate monsters swim in it.
levels.theme: chocolate waterfall, cocoa banks, candy cane bridges

levels.name: Candy Cane Forest
levels.description: all the trees are candy canes and they come ALIVE and try to poke you.
levels.theme: candy cane trees, peppermint ground, sugar snow

levels.name: The Ice Cream Caves
levels.description: its freezing in here because its ALL ice cream and it drips on you.
levels.theme: ice cream stalactites, waffle cone walls, sprinkle ground

levels.name: Sugar Fortress
levels.description: a HUGE fortress made entirely of sugar. one wrong step and it cracks.
levels.theme: sugar brick walls, frosting mortar, gumdrop towers

levels.name: Cake Boss Castle
levels.description: the Cake Boss lives here and he decorated his castle to look beautiful but hes MEAN.
levels.theme: wedding cake layers, fondant walls, candle towers

boss.name: Gummy King
boss.description: hes a GIANT gummy bear and you hit him and he just bounces back. so annoying

weapon.name: Licorice Whip
weapon.description: it stretches AND it stings

armor.name: Hard Candy Armor
armor.description: its the hardest candy there is. jawbreaker armor

designs.victory_message: the gummy king melted!! he got too warm from all the fighting!!
designs.defeat_message: the gummy king sat on you. squish.

boss.name: Chocolate Dragon
boss.description: it breathes HOT chocolate at you which sounds nice but it BURNS

weapon.name: Mint Blade
weapon.description: chocolate and mint go together but this time it HURTS

armor.name: Wrapper Shield
armor.description: the foil wrapper reflects the hot chocolate

designs.victory_message: the chocolate dragon hardened!! hes a chocolate statue now!!
designs.defeat_message: the chocolate dragon melted you. death by chocolate.

boss.name: Candy Cane Golem
boss.description: hes made of ALL the candy canes twisted together and hes REALLY poky

weapon.name: Candy Crusher
weapon.description: it smashes candy into tiny pieces

armor.name: Gingerbread Armor
armor.description: the gingerbread man would be jealous

designs.victory_message: the candy cane golem crumbled!! nothing but crumbs!!
designs.defeat_message: the candy cane golem poked you from every direction. ouch.

boss.name: Brain Freeze
boss.description: its a LIVING ice cream headache and it freezes EVERYTHING

weapon.name: Hot Fudge Sword
weapon.description: it melts ice cream monsters on contact

armor.name: Waffle Cone Armor
armor.description: crunchy and protective

designs.victory_message: brain freeze melted away!! no more headaches!!
designs.defeat_message: brain freeze froze your WHOLE body. popsicle you.

boss.name: Sugar Golem
boss.description: hes ENORMOUS and made of pure sugar and every hit makes him crack

weapon.name: Cavity Blade
weapon.description: it makes sugar monsters get cavities and CRUMBLE

armor.name: Jawbreaker Shield
armor.description: unbreakable. thats why its called that

designs.victory_message: the sugar golem dissolved!! just a sweet puddle now!!
designs.defeat_message: the sugar golem crushed you under his sugar foot.

boss.name: The Cake Boss
boss.description: he decorates EVERYTHING and then it comes alive and attacks you. his cake is FIVE layers tall

weapon.name: Birthday Candle Sword
weapon.description: its on fire and it NEVER goes out no matter how hard you blow

armor.name: Layer Cake Armor
armor.description: five layers of protection!!

designs.victory_message: THE CAKE BOSS IS BAKED!! the whole candy land is saved!!
designs.defeat_message: the cake boss put you IN the cake. youre a decoration now.

overworld.name: Robot City
overworld.description: the robots took over the city! they beep and boop and try to laser you. everything is metal and shiny and goes BZZT.

levels.name: Factory Floor
levels.description: this is where they MAKE the robots. theres conveyor belts and robot arms everywhere.
levels.theme: assembly line, conveyor belts, sparks

levels.name: Circuit Streets
levels.description: the streets have circuits IN them and they light up when robots walk on them.
levels.theme: glowing roads, robot houses, data streams

levels.name: The Server Room
levels.description: SO many computers in here. the robots get smarter the deeper you go.
levels.theme: server racks, blinking lights, cable tangles

levels.name: Drone Highway
levels.description: drones flying EVERYWHERE. they have little lasers and theyre REALLY accurate.
levels.theme: flight paths, drone pads, targeting systems

levels.name: Robot Arena
levels.description: the robots have GLADIATOR fights here and now YOU have to fight in them too.
levels.theme: arena floor, spectator bots, weapon racks

levels.name: The Core
levels.description: the MAIN computer that controls ALL the robots is in here. shut it down and they all stop.
levels.theme: central processor, power conduits, AI chamber

boss.name: Assembly Bot
boss.description: it keeps BUILDING itself bigger and bigger while you fight it

weapon.name: EMP Sword
weapon.description: one hit and the robots go BZZZ and shut off

armor.name: Circuit Armor
armor.description: it makes you look like a robot so they get confused

designs.victory_message: the assembly bot fell apart!! just spare parts now!!
designs.defeat_message: the assembly bot built too many friends. you were outnumbered.

boss.name: Grid Master
boss.description: he controls all the electricity and he can turn the FLOOR into a weapon

weapon.name: Surge Blade
weapon.description: it absorbs electricity and gets STRONGER

armor.name: Insulated Suit
armor.description: electricity just tickles now

designs.victory_message: the grid master ran out of power!! lights out!!
designs.defeat_message: the grid master electrified everything. bzzt.

boss.name: Server Mind
boss.description: its not even a robot its a COMPUTER that thinks and it knows EVERYTHING about you

weapon.name: Debug Hammer
weapon.description: it finds bugs in the robots and CRASHES them

armor.name: Firewall Shield
armor.description: blocks ALL the data attacks

designs.victory_message: server mind got a blue screen of death!! CTRL ALT DEFEATED!!
designs.defeat_message: server mind hacked your brain. does not compute.

boss.name: Mega Drone
boss.description: its the size of a HOUSE and it has like FIFTY lasers

weapon.name: Anti-Air Blade
weapon.description: it knocks flying things right out of the sky

armor.name: Drone Jammer Armor
armor.description: drones cant even FIND you

designs.victory_message: the mega drone crashed!! biggest crash EVER!!
designs.defeat_message: the mega drone had too many lasers. pew pew pew.

boss.name: Gladiator Prime
boss.description: the CHAMPION robot fighter. undefeated. until NOW hopefully

weapon.name: Champion Blade
weapon.description: the best weapon in the arena. you earned it

armor.name: Trophy Armor
armor.description: its made from all the trophies

designs.victory_message: gladiator prime is defeated!! the crowd goes wild!! the robot crowd!!
designs.defeat_message: gladiator prime was just too tough. better luck next time.

boss.name: The AI
boss.description: the MAIN brain. it controls EVERY robot and it does NOT want to be turned off

weapon.name: Shutdown Key
weapon.description: its not really a sword its a KEY but it shuts down EVERYTHING

armor.name: Admin Armor
armor.description: it gives you admin access. root privileges

designs.victory_message: THE AI IS SHUT DOWN!! all the robots stopped!! beep... boop... silence!!
designs.defeat_message: the AI was too smart. it turned your own weapons against you.

overworld.name: Dinosaur Island
overworld.description: THERES DINOSAURS. real ones!! well game ones. they stomp around and try to eat you and some of them are REALLY REALLY big.

levels.name: The Beach
levels.description: you wash up on the beach and right away theres RAPTORS running at you.
levels.theme: sandy beach, palm trees, raptor tracks

levels.name: Jungle Path
levels.description: the jungle is THICK and you can hear dinosaurs everywhere but you cant SEE them.
levels.theme: dense jungle, giant ferns, hidden paths

levels.name: Bone Valley
levels.description: theres dinosaur bones EVERYWHERE. and some of them get up and WALK.
levels.theme: fossil beds, bone piles, skeleton formations

levels.name: Tar Pits
levels.description: SO sticky. the tar pits are bubbling and stuff gets STUCK in them forever.
levels.theme: bubbling tar, trapped bones, steam vents

levels.name: Volcano Valley
levels.description: theres a volcano AND dinosaurs. worst combo EVER.
levels.theme: volcanic terrain, fire dinosaurs, lava streams

levels.name: Rex Mountain
levels.description: the T-REX lives at the top. THE biggest dinosaur. his teeth are bigger than YOUR WHOLE BODY.
levels.theme: mountain peak, rex nest, massive footprints

boss.name: Beach Rex
boss.description: a smaller t-rex but still HUGE and he guards the beach

weapon.name: Bone Club
weapon.description: a dinosaur bone. hitting dinosaurs with their own bones. ironic

armor.name: Shell Armor
armor.description: giant turtle shell. really hard

designs.victory_message: the beach rex ran into the jungle!! the beach is safe!!
designs.defeat_message: the beach rex got you. his little arms are surprisingly strong.

boss.name: Jungle Stalker
boss.description: you cant even SEE it coming. it hides in the leaves and then POUNCE

weapon.name: Machete
weapon.description: it cuts through the jungle AND through dinosaurs

armor.name: Vine Armor
armor.description: all the vines wrapped around you as protection

designs.victory_message: the jungle stalker fled!! the jungle is quiet. TOO quiet. nah its fine.
designs.defeat_message: the jungle stalker got the drop on you. never saw it coming.

boss.name: Bone Tyrant
boss.description: a SKELETON dinosaur that came back to life. how is that even possible

weapon.name: Fossil Sword
weapon.description: its made of the hardest fossil ever found

armor.name: Rib Cage Armor
armor.description: wearing a dinosaur rib cage as armor is SO cool

designs.victory_message: the bone tyrant crumbled!! back to being just bones!!
designs.defeat_message: the bone tyrant added YOUR bones to his collection.

boss.name: Tar Beast
boss.description: it lives IN the tar and it pulls you under. it smells TERRIBLE

weapon.name: Long Spear
weapon.description: you can poke it from far away so you dont get stuck

armor.name: Oil Slick Armor
armor.description: too slippery for tar to stick

designs.victory_message: the tar beast sank into its own tar!! bye bye stinky!!
designs.defeat_message: the tar beast pulled you in. stuck. forever. gross.

boss.name: Fire Raptor
boss.description: a raptor thats ON FIRE. a fire raptor. it runs SO fast

weapon.name: Ice Spear
weapon.description: it melts a little every time you use it but it works great on fire dinos

armor.name: Volcanic Scale Armor
armor.description: the fire cant get through it

designs.victory_message: the fire raptor cooled off!! just a regular raptor now! still scary but less!!
designs.defeat_message: the fire raptor set everything on fire. including you.

boss.name: MEGA REX
boss.description: THE. BIGGEST. DINOSAUR. his head is as big as a HOUSE and each tooth is as big as YOU

weapon.name: Rex Bane
weapon.description: the ancient weapon. the one thing mega rex is scared of

armor.name: Dino Plate Mail
armor.description: the strongest armor from all the dino stuff you found

designs.victory_message: MEGA REX IS DOWN!! the whole island felt THAT one!!
designs.defeat_message: mega rex stepped on you. its over. he didnt even notice.

overworld.name: Ghost House
overworld.description: its a haunted house and ALL the ghosts are real. they go BOOOO and walk through walls and youre like AHHH and its SO scary.

levels.name: Front Porch
levels.description: the door creaks open by ITSELF and cold air comes out. something is watching.
levels.theme: creaky porch, cobwebs, flickering lights

levels.name: Living Room
levels.description: the furniture moves by itself and the paintings WATCH you. the eyes follow you around.
levels.theme: moving furniture, haunted paintings, cold spots

levels.name: The Kitchen
levels.description: the knives are floating. THE KNIVES ARE FLOATING. also the food is all rotten.
levels.theme: floating utensils, rotten food, bubbling pots

levels.name: Upstairs Hallway
levels.description: the hallway keeps getting LONGER the more you walk. and the doors open and close.
levels.theme: infinite hallway, slamming doors, shifting walls

levels.name: The Nursery
levels.description: the creepiest room. toys move by themselves and a music box plays but nobody wound it up.
levels.theme: rocking horse, music box, moving dolls

levels.name: The Attic
levels.description: the main ghost is up here. the one that haunted the WHOLE house. time to face it.
levels.theme: dusty attic, old trunks, glowing apparition

boss.name: Porch Phantom
boss.description: hes the greeter ghost. he scares people BEFORE they even get inside

weapon.name: Spirit Blade
weapon.description: it can actually HIT ghosts which most swords cant

armor.name: Ghost Ward Cloak
armor.description: ghosts go right THROUGH you now. wait thats what THEY do

designs.victory_message: the porch phantom is gone!! the front door is safe now!!
designs.defeat_message: the porch phantom scared you so bad you just LEFT.

boss.name: Poltergeist
boss.description: it throws EVERYTHING at you. chairs tables lamps EVERYTHING

weapon.name: Exorcism Wand
weapon.description: point it at furniture and it stops being haunted

armor.name: Holy Shield
armor.description: blessed by a priest. ghosts HATE it

designs.victory_message: the poltergeist ran out of stuff to throw!! everything is broken but youre OK!!
designs.defeat_message: the poltergeist threw a piano at you. pianos are heavy.

boss.name: Chef Specter
boss.description: a ghost chef who cooks POISON food and throws KNIVES

weapon.name: Silver Fork
weapon.description: three prongs of ghost-fighting power

armor.name: Kitchen Pot Armor
armor.description: wearing a pot on your head actually WORKS

designs.victory_message: the chef specter served his last meal!! kitchen closed!!
designs.defeat_message: the chef specter served you a knuckle sandwich. ghost knuckle.

boss.name: The Warden
boss.description: it keeps the hallway going FOREVER and you can never find the exit

weapon.name: Compass Blade
weapon.description: it always points to the exit so the hallway cant trick you

armor.name: Map Shield
armor.description: shows you the REAL layout not the ghost one

designs.victory_message: the warden is gone and the hallway is NORMAL LENGTH again!!
designs.defeat_message: the hallway went forever and you walked and walked and walked and...

boss.name: The Doll
boss.description: the CREEPIEST doll ever. its eyes follow you and it giggles and its NOT funny

weapon.name: Toy Breaker
weapon.description: it breaks haunted toys so they stop being scary

armor.name: Blanket Shield
armor.description: the strongest blanket fort. ghosts cant get in blankets everyone knows that

designs.victory_message: the doll stopped moving!! its just a regular creepy doll now!!
designs.defeat_message: the doll giggled and everything went dark. nope nope nope.

boss.name: The House Ghost
boss.description: THE original ghost. the one who STARTED the haunting a hundred years ago. hes FURIOUS

weapon.name: Exorcist Sword
weapon.description: the ULTIMATE ghost weapon. blessed SEVEN times

armor.name: Phantom Plate
armor.description: you become PART ghost. the good part

designs.victory_message: THE HOUSE GHOST IS BANISHED!! the house is just a regular house now!! still creepy looking though!!
designs.defeat_message: the house ghost banished YOU instead. now youre the ghost. oh no.

overworld.name: Pirate Ocean
overworld.description: PIRATES!! theyre on boats and they have swords and they go ARRR. the whole ocean is full of pirate ships and sea monsters.

levels.name: The Dock
levels.description: pirate ships everywhere and the dock is full of mean sailors.
levels.theme: wooden docks, barrels, rope piles

levels.name: Below Deck
levels.description: dark and cramped and rats and pirates playing cards. they cheat.
levels.theme: ship interior, cannons, hammocks

levels.name: Treasure Island
levels.description: an island with buried treasure but the treasure is GUARDED by skeleton pirates.
levels.theme: sandy island, palm trees, treasure maps, skeletons

levels.name: Storm Sea
levels.description: the ocean is going CRAZY with waves and lightning and the pirates LOVE it.
levels.theme: stormy waves, lightning, rain, whirlpools

levels.name: Pirate Fortress
levels.description: the pirates built a fortress on a cliff and its full of cannons.
levels.theme: stone fortress, cannons, pirate flags

levels.name: The Flagship
levels.description: the PIRATE KING'S ship. the biggest ship on the ocean. it has FIFTY cannons.
levels.theme: massive ship, gold trim, captain's quarters

boss.name: Dock Boss
boss.description: the biggest pirate on the dock. he smells like fish and hits like an anchor

weapon.name: Cutlass
weapon.description: a real pirate sword! it goes SWISH SWISH

armor.name: Barrel Lid Shield
armor.description: round and sturdy

designs.victory_message: the dock is clear!! no more smelly pirates!!
designs.defeat_message: the dock boss threw you in the ocean. splosh.

boss.name: First Mate
boss.description: second in command and TWICE as mean. he has two swords

weapon.name: Boarding Axe
weapon.description: chops through everything. pirate doors ship walls bad guys

armor.name: Brass Plate
armor.description: shiny ship brass. looks cool AND protects

designs.victory_message: the first mate surrendered!! hes swabbing the deck now!!
designs.defeat_message: the first mate walked you off the plank. SPLASH.

boss.name: Skeleton Admiral
boss.description: a pirate who DIED but kept pirating. bones and all

weapon.name: Blessed Blade
weapon.description: it glows near undead pirates. handy AND pretty

armor.name: Treasure Armor
armor.description: made of gold coins. heavy but fancy

designs.victory_message: the skeleton admiral is re-dead!! finally resting!!
designs.defeat_message: the skeleton admiral recruited you. youre a skeleton pirate now.

boss.name: Storm Kraken
boss.description: it comes up during storms and grabs ships with its tentacles

weapon.name: Storm Cutter
weapon.description: cuts through rain AND tentacles

armor.name: Oilskin Armor
armor.description: waterproof! the storm cant soak you

designs.victory_message: the storm kraken dove back under!! seas are calm!!
designs.defeat_message: the storm kraken pulled you under during a wave. glub.

boss.name: Commodore Blackfang
boss.description: he has ACTUAL fangs and he commands the whole fortress

weapon.name: Admiral Saber
weapon.description: the finest sword on the seven seas

armor.name: Fortress Plate
armor.description: stone and iron. nothing gets through

designs.victory_message: the fortress fell!! blackfang lost his teeth too!!
designs.defeat_message: commodore blackfang blasted you with all fifty cannons.

boss.name: PIRATE KING
boss.description: the KING of ALL pirates. his beard is on FIRE and he has a sword made of SHARK TEETH

weapon.name: Kings Tooth
weapon.description: a sword made from the pirate kings own broken tooth. poetic justice

armor.name: Sea Dragon Armor
armor.description: the strongest armor on all the oceans

designs.victory_message: THE PIRATE KING IS DETHRONED!! the ocean is free!!
designs.defeat_message: the pirate king fired ALL fifty cannons at once. boom.

overworld.name: Bug World
overworld.description: you shrunk down REALLY small and now the bugs are bigger than you!! everything is enormous. a leaf is like a BUILDING.

levels.name: The Garden
levels.description: youre in a garden but everything is HUGE. the grass is like a forest.
levels.theme: giant grass blades, pebble mountains, dewdrops

levels.name: Ant Tunnels
levels.description: the ants have TUNNELS everywhere and they work together and theyre really organized.
levels.theme: dirt tunnels, ant paths, food storage

levels.name: Spider Web City
levels.description: theres webs EVERYWHERE and the spiders sit in the middle waiting for you to get stuck.
levels.theme: massive webs, silk bridges, trapped bugs

levels.name: The Puddle Sea
levels.description: a puddle is like an OCEAN when youre this small. theres water bugs sailing on it.
levels.theme: huge puddle, floating leaves, water surface

levels.name: Beehive
levels.description: you went INSIDE a beehive. the bees are NOT happy about it. theres honey everywhere.
levels.theme: honeycomb walls, wax floor, buzzing bees

levels.name: Beetle King Throne
levels.description: the BIGGEST beetle ever. hes got a horn on his head and armor that nothing can crack.
levels.theme: massive beetle shell, horn throne, chitin walls

boss.name: Garden Spider
boss.description: not THAT big for a spider but when youre tiny ITS ENORMOUS

weapon.name: Thorn Sword
weapon.description: a thorn from a rose. super sharp at this size

armor.name: Acorn Cap Shield
armor.description: a perfect little shield

designs.victory_message: the garden spider ran away!! the garden is safe!! for now!!
designs.defeat_message: the garden spider got you in its web. sticky.

boss.name: Ant General
boss.description: she commands a THOUSAND ants and they all do exactly what she says

weapon.name: Pin Sword
weapon.description: a sewing pin. its a perfect tiny sword

armor.name: Thimble Armor
armor.description: a thimble fits perfectly as a helmet AND body armor

designs.victory_message: the ant general retreated!! the colony backed off!!
designs.defeat_message: the ants carried you away. youre food now.

boss.name: Web Empress
boss.description: the biggest spider in the web and she can feel EVERY vibration

weapon.name: Silk Cutter
weapon.description: it slices through webs like nothing

armor.name: Chitin Armor
armor.description: made from shed bug shells. gross but effective

designs.victory_message: the web empress web is destroyed!! she scurried away!!
designs.defeat_message: the web empress wrapped you up like a burrito. a bug burrito.

boss.name: Water Strider King
boss.description: he walks ON the water and he can pull you UNDER

weapon.name: Reed Lance
weapon.description: long and poky and great for water fights

armor.name: Leaf Boat Armor
armor.description: you float AND youre protected

designs.victory_message: the water strider king sank!! he cant walk on water anymore!!
designs.defeat_message: the water strider king pulled you under the puddle sea. blub.

boss.name: Queen Bee
boss.description: the QUEEN. shes huge and she has the biggest stinger youve ever SEEN

weapon.name: Stinger Blade
weapon.description: its a bee stinger you found. one use only... no wait its magic

armor.name: Beeswax Armor
armor.description: sealed tight. no stingers getting through

designs.victory_message: the queen bee called her bees off!! truce!! you can have some honey!!
designs.defeat_message: the queen bee stung you. OUCH. that was a BIG stinger.

boss.name: BEETLE KING
boss.description: his shell is INDESTRUCTIBLE and his horn can flip ANYTHING. hes been king for a thousand bug years

weapon.name: Diamond Needle
weapon.description: the ONLY thing that can scratch the beetle kings shell

armor.name: Royal Chitin
armor.description: the strongest bug armor in existence

designs.victory_message: THE BEETLE KING IS FLIPPED!! he cant get back up!! victory!!
designs.defeat_message: the beetle king flipped you instead. horn power.

overworld.name: Ice Kingdom
overworld.description: BRRR its SO cold. everything is ice and snow and the bad guys are all frozen and cold and they want to freeze YOU too.

levels.name: Frost Fields
levels.description: snow everywhere and its really slippery and ice monsters pop out of snowdrifts.
levels.theme: snow plains, ice patches, frozen trees

levels.name: Ice Caves
levels.description: everything is blue and shiny and icicles fall from the ceiling if you make noise.
levels.theme: ice caverns, crystal formations, frozen pools

levels.name: The Glacier
levels.description: the glacier is MOVING really slowly and the ice monsters ride it like a bus.
levels.theme: massive glacier, crevasses, ice walls

levels.name: Snowstorm Peak
levels.description: you cant see ANYTHING because the snow is blowing SO hard and its SO cold.
levels.theme: blizzard conditions, white-out, howling wind

levels.name: Frozen Palace
levels.description: a whole PALACE made of ice. its beautiful but the ice queen does NOT like visitors.
levels.theme: ice pillars, frozen fountains, crystal chandeliers

levels.name: The Frozen Throne
levels.description: the ice queen sits on a throne of PURE ice and she can freeze you with just a LOOK.
levels.theme: ice throne, frozen warriors, arctic wind

boss.name: Frost Giant
boss.description: hes made of packed snow and ice and hes REALLY tall and throws snowballs that HURT

weapon.name: Flame Sword
weapon.description: it MELTS ice monsters. sizzle sizzle

armor.name: Fur Cloak
armor.description: SO warm. the cold cant get you

designs.victory_message: the frost giant melted!! hes just a puddle now!!
designs.defeat_message: the frost giant froze you into an ice cube. brrr.

boss.name: Crystal Golem
boss.description: hes see-through and super hard and when light hits him he shoots LASERS

weapon.name: Heat Blade
weapon.description: it stays warm no matter what and cuts through ice

armor.name: Crystal Armor
armor.description: its ice but the GOOD kind that protects you

designs.victory_message: the crystal golem shattered!! pretty but defeated!!
designs.defeat_message: the crystal golem froze you solid. a human popsicle.

boss.name: Glacier Wurm
boss.description: it burrows THROUGH the glacier and pops up under your feet

weapon.name: Pick Axe
weapon.description: it breaks ice AND monsters equally well

armor.name: Glacier Plate
armor.description: thick as a glacier. cold but tough

designs.victory_message: the glacier wurm burrowed away!! the glacier stopped shaking!!
designs.defeat_message: the glacier wurm pulled you under the ice. cold and dark.

boss.name: Blizzard Elemental
boss.description: its made of the STORM ITSELF. how do you fight a storm??

weapon.name: Calm Blade
weapon.description: it makes storms stop. the blizzard elemental HATES that

armor.name: Storm Shelter Armor
armor.description: a whole shelter you wear. the wind cant touch you

designs.victory_message: the blizzard stopped!! you can finally SEE again!!
designs.defeat_message: the blizzard elemental buried you in snow. so. much. snow.

boss.name: Ice Queen Guard
boss.description: the queens personal guard. covered in ICE armor and ice weapons

weapon.name: Sun Blade
weapon.description: it shines like the SUN and ice cant exist near it

armor.name: Phoenix Cloak
armor.description: so warm it makes steam in the ice palace

designs.victory_message: the guard is defeated!! the queen has no protection now!!
designs.defeat_message: the guard froze your weapons. cant fight with frozen swords.

boss.name: Ice Queen
boss.description: she controls ALL the cold EVERYWHERE and she can freeze you with just a LOOK. dont look at her eyes

weapon.name: Crown Of Warmth
weapon.description: its not a sword its a crown and it makes you immune to her freezing gaze

armor.name: Sun Plate
armor.description: the armor of SUMMER. the ice queen HATES summer

designs.victory_message: THE ICE QUEEN MELTED HER OWN THRONE CRYING!! wait thats sad. BUT YOU WON!!
designs.defeat_message: the ice queen froze time itself. everything stopped. forever cold.

overworld.name: Dream Land
overworld.description: youre ASLEEP and everything is weird. stairs go sideways and the sky is purple and nothing makes sense. a bad dream with bad guys.

levels.name: Fuzzy Meadow
levels.description: the grass is all fuzzy and the flowers talk but they dont say nice things.
levels.theme: dreamlike meadow, talking flowers, cotton clouds

levels.name: Upside Down House
levels.description: the house is upside down! the ceiling is the floor. everything falls UP.
levels.theme: inverted furniture, gravity reversed, confusion

levels.name: Clock Tower
levels.description: time goes BACKWARDS and FORWARDS and SIDEWAYS in here. the clocks are all different.
levels.theme: spinning clocks, time warps, frozen moments

levels.name: Nightmare Swamp
levels.description: the dreams get BAD here. its all dark and scary and things chase you that you cant see.
levels.theme: dark mist, shadow creatures, sinking ground

levels.name: Mirror Maze
levels.description: EVERY wall is a mirror and your reflections move DIFFERENTLY than you. creepy.
levels.theme: infinite mirrors, false reflections, echo chambers

levels.name: The Dreamer
levels.description: the thing MAKING the bad dream. its a giant floating EYE and it sees EVERYTHING.
levels.theme: floating eye, dream void, psychic waves

boss.name: Meadow Nightmare
boss.description: it LOOKS friendly but then it turns into your worst fear

weapon.name: Wake-Up Sword
weapon.description: hit something with it and it wakes up from being evil

armor.name: Dream Catcher Armor
armor.description: catches the bad dreams before they get you

designs.victory_message: the meadow is a GOOD dream now!! flowers are nice again!!
designs.defeat_message: the meadow nightmare found your worst fear. yikes.

boss.name: Gravity Ghost
boss.description: it flips gravity whenever it WANTS and you fall on the ceiling

weapon.name: Balance Blade
weapon.description: it keeps you steady no matter which way is down

armor.name: Gravity Boots
armor.description: you stick to whatever youre standing on

designs.victory_message: the gravity ghost lost its power!! everything fell back to normal!!
designs.defeat_message: gravity flipped and you fell up and then down and then up and.

boss.name: Time Troll
boss.description: it reverses your attacks so you UNHIT things. thats so unfair

weapon.name: Chrono Blade
weapon.description: it hits in ALL times at once

armor.name: Time Shield
armor.description: attacks from the past cant get you

designs.victory_message: the time troll is stuck in a loop!! the same second forever!!
designs.defeat_message: the time troll sent you back to the start. wait what.

boss.name: Night Terror
boss.description: the SCARIEST thing in the dream. it IS fear. literally just FEAR in monster form

weapon.name: Brave Sword
weapon.description: the braver you are the STRONGER it gets

armor.name: Courage Armor
armor.description: fear just bounces off

designs.victory_message: the night terror disappeared because you were TOO BRAVE for it!!
designs.defeat_message: the night terror was too scary. you woke up screaming. but then you were back in the dream.

boss.name: Mirror Self
boss.description: its YOU but EVIL and it knows every move youre gonna make

weapon.name: Truth Blade
weapon.description: it hits the REAL one not the reflections

armor.name: One-Way Mirror Shield
armor.description: you can see them but they cant see you

designs.victory_message: your mirror self merged back into you!! youre whole again!!
designs.defeat_message: your mirror self replaced you. now YOURE the reflection.

boss.name: The Dreamer
boss.description: a GIANT floating EYE that dreams ALL the bad dreams. if you beat it you WAKE UP

weapon.name: Alarm Clock Sword
weapon.description: RING RING RING it wakes everything up

armor.name: Lucid Armor
armor.description: you KNOW youre dreaming so nothing can hurt you

designs.victory_message: THE DREAMER BLINKED AND DISAPPEARED!! youre waking up!! GOOD MORNING!!
designs.defeat_message: the dreamer put you in a dream inside a dream. dreamception. youre stuck.

overworld.name: Space Station
overworld.description: YOURE IN SPACE!! theres aliens and they have ray guns and everything floats around. the station is HUGE.

levels.name: Docking Bay
levels.description: where the ships park. some of the ships are full of aliens and they dont have tickets.
levels.theme: space ships, cargo crates, airlock doors

levels.name: Crew Quarters
levels.description: where the people USED to sleep. now the aliens sleep here and they snore LASER BEAMS.
levels.theme: bunk beds, lockers, zero gravity

levels.name: Bio Lab
levels.description: the science part where they grow alien plants and SOME of the plants escaped.
levels.theme: containment pods, alien plants, hazmat suits

levels.name: Engine Room
levels.description: the engines are HUGE and loud and the aliens hooked them up to make weapons.
levels.theme: massive engines, power conduits, fire vents

levels.name: Command Bridge
levels.description: this is where the captain USED to be. now the alien commander sits there.
levels.theme: control panels, viewscreen, captain chair

levels.name: Alien Mothership
levels.description: docked to the station is the ALIEN MOTHERSHIP and the alien boss is inside.
levels.theme: organic walls, alien tech, hive chamber

boss.name: Dock Boss
boss.description: the biggest alien. he loads cargo but the cargo is WEAPONS

weapon.name: Laser Sword
weapon.description: it goes VWOOM VWOOM like in the movies

armor.name: Space Suit
armor.description: protects from aliens AND from space

designs.victory_message: the dock is secured!! no more alien ships getting in!!
designs.defeat_message: the dock boss threw you out the airlock. floaty.

boss.name: Sleep Alien
boss.description: it attacks you IN YOUR DREAMS while you sleep and in REAL LIFE at the same time

weapon.name: Coffee Blade
weapon.description: it keeps you AWAKE so the sleep alien cant get you

armor.name: Insomnia Shield
armor.description: you never sleep again. wait is that good

designs.victory_message: the sleep alien is the one sleeping now!! SNORE!!
designs.defeat_message: the sleep alien put you to sleep forever. zzzzz.

boss.name: Bio Horror
boss.description: it was a science experiment that went WRONG and now its HUGE and ANGRY

weapon.name: Flamethrower Sword
weapon.description: fire AND sword. science fiction at its finest

armor.name: Hazmat Armor
armor.description: nothing gross or alien can touch you

designs.victory_message: the bio horror is back in its containment pod!! science wins!!
designs.defeat_message: the bio horror absorbed you. youre part of the experiment now.

boss.name: Engine Beast
boss.description: it LIVES in the engine. it IS the engine. the engine grew a face

weapon.name: Coolant Blade
weapon.description: it makes things SO cold the engine beast cant handle it

armor.name: Heat Shield
armor.description: the engines are really hot but this armor doesnt care

designs.victory_message: the engine beast shut down!! the engine works NORMALLY now!!
designs.defeat_message: the engine beast overheated you. too much engine.

boss.name: Alien Commander
boss.description: she has SIX arms and each one has a different weapon. thats a LOT of weapons

weapon.name: Override Key
weapon.description: its a sword shaped like a key. or a key shaped like a sword

armor.name: Command Armor
armor.description: the captain wore it. it has authority AND protection

designs.victory_message: the commander surrendered!! she dropped ALL six weapons!!
designs.defeat_message: the commander used all six weapons at once. no fair.

boss.name: HIVE QUEEN
boss.description: the queen of ALL the aliens. she lays eggs that hatch into MORE aliens while you fight

weapon.name: Nova Blade
weapon.description: one swing and it explodes with STAR power

armor.name: Void Armor
armor.description: the ultimate space protection

designs.victory_message: THE HIVE QUEEN IS DEFEATED!! the aliens are leaving the station!!
designs.defeat_message: the hive queen hatched too many aliens. you were outnumbered a billion to one.

overworld.name: Dragon Mountain
overworld.description: theres a mountain FULL of dragons. little ones, big ones, and the BIGGEST one at the top. they ALL breathe fire.

levels.name: Foothills
levels.description: baby dragons at the bottom. theyre small but they still breathe fire. little fires.
levels.theme: rocky hills, dragon footprints, scorched grass

levels.name: Cave Network
levels.description: the mountain is FULL of caves and dragons sleep in ALL of them.
levels.theme: dragon caves, treasure hoards, sleeping dragons

levels.name: Dragon Nursery
levels.description: where the dragon EGGS are. the mom dragons here are SUPER protective.
levels.theme: nests, eggs, dragon mothers, warm air

levels.name: Magma Tunnels
levels.description: under the mountain theres tunnels full of magma and FIRE dragons live here.
levels.theme: magma rivers, fire crystals, heat vents

levels.name: Sky Perch
levels.description: the TOP of the mountain where the flying dragons launch from. the wind is INSANE.
levels.theme: mountain peak, launch ledges, wind currents, clouds

levels.name: Elder Dragon Lair
levels.description: THE dragon. the OLDEST one. the one ALL the other dragons are scared of. even the big ones.
levels.theme: massive cavern, ancient treasure, dragon throne

boss.name: Hill Drake
boss.description: the toughest dragon at the bottom. hes small but he breathes fire REALLY far

weapon.name: Drake Fang
weapon.description: a baby dragons tooth. still sharp enough

armor.name: Scale Mail
armor.description: dragon scales shed. free armor

designs.victory_message: the hill drake flew away!! the foothills are safe to walk through!!
designs.defeat_message: the hill drake toasted you. well done. literally.

boss.name: Cave Dragon
boss.description: it sleeps on a MOUNTAIN of gold and if you take ONE coin it wakes up

weapon.name: Crystal Blade
weapon.description: it glows in the dark and cuts through dragon scales

armor.name: Gold Armor
armor.description: heavy because its GOLD but nothing gets through

designs.victory_message: the cave dragon went back to sleep!! on less treasure but whatever!!
designs.defeat_message: the cave dragon woke up ANGRY. shouldnt have touched the gold.

boss.name: Mama Drake
boss.description: she is FURIOUS that youre near her eggs and she breathes the HOTTEST fire

weapon.name: Peace Staff
weapon.description: it calms dragons down. sometimes. hopefully

armor.name: Fireproof Cloak
armor.description: mama drakes fire cant touch you

designs.victory_message: mama drake calmed down!! she just wanted to protect her babies!!
designs.defeat_message: mama drake sat on you like you were an egg. squish.

boss.name: Magma Wyrm
boss.description: it SWIMS through magma and pops up where you LEAST expect it

weapon.name: Frost Lance
weapon.description: it freezes magma solid. the wyrm HATES cold

armor.name: Magma Plate
armor.description: forged IN magma. nothing hotter can exist

designs.victory_message: the magma wyrm froze solid!! a magma popsicle!!
designs.defeat_message: the magma wyrm surfaced right under you. splash. hot splash.

boss.name: Storm Dragon
boss.description: it creates HURRICANES by flapping its wings. each wing is bigger than a house

weapon.name: Storm Anchor
weapon.description: so heavy even the storm dragons wind cant move you. and it HITS hard

armor.name: Wing Suit
armor.description: you can glide on the wind instead of getting blown away

designs.victory_message: the storm dragon lost its storm!! just a regular flappy dragon now!!
designs.defeat_message: the storm dragon blew you off the mountain. its a long way down.

boss.name: ELDER DRAGON
boss.description: the OLDEST and BIGGEST dragon. been alive for TEN THOUSAND years. breathes fire so hot it melts STONE

weapon.name: Dragonbane
weapon.description: the LEGENDARY sword. the one from the prophecy. THE prophecy

armor.name: Dragon Knight Armor
armor.description: the strongest armor. blessed by the good dragons

designs.victory_message: THE ELDER DRAGON BOWED TO YOU!! you earned its respect!! the mountain is peaceful!!
designs.defeat_message: the elder dragon breathed fire that melts EVERYTHING. even the game screen. ok not really.

overworld.name: Dark Castle
overworld.description: the LAST castle. the DARKEST one. the WORST bad guys. if you made it this far you can PROBABLY do it. maybe.

levels.name: The Moat
levels.description: theres a moat full of DARK water and things swim in it that you DO NOT want to see.
levels.theme: dark water, drawbridge, arrow slits

levels.name: The Dungeon
levels.description: prisoners used to be here. now only monsters are here. and theyre not locked up.
levels.theme: chains, cells, torture devices, dripping walls

levels.name: Poison Gallery
levels.description: the walls DRIP poison and every painting hides a trap behind it.
levels.theme: poison walls, trapped paintings, acid pools

levels.name: Shadow Barracks
levels.description: the shadow army sleeps here. THOUSANDS of them. dont wake them ALL up.
levels.theme: shadow beds, dark armor racks, ghostly glow

levels.name: The Tower
levels.description: the tallest tower. you climb and climb and every floor has WORSE enemies.
levels.theme: spiral staircase, narrow rooms, wind howling

levels.name: The Throne Of Darkness
levels.description: THE final boss of the WHOLE game. the Dark Lord. hes been waiting for you THIS WHOLE TIME.
levels.theme: obsidian throne, dark flames, final arena

boss.name: Moat Horror
boss.description: it comes OUT of the moat and its all slimy and has tentacles and it SMELLS

weapon.name: Light Blade
weapon.description: it glows bright in the dark and dark monsters HATE light

armor.name: Shadow Ward
armor.description: darkness cant touch you

designs.victory_message: the moat horror sank back under!! the bridge is clear!!
designs.defeat_message: the moat horror pulled you under the dark water. you dont want to know whats down there.

boss.name: The Warden
boss.description: he has the keys to EVERY cell and he puts heroes in them FOREVER

weapon.name: Key Sword
weapon.description: it opens locks AND fights bad guys. two in one

armor.name: Chain Mail
armor.description: real chain mail. from the dungeon. ironic

designs.victory_message: the warden is locked in his OWN cell!! how do you like it!!
designs.defeat_message: the warden threw you in a cell. no key. no escape. no good.

boss.name: Venom Queen
boss.description: she controls ALL the poison in the castle and she can make it go ANYWHERE

weapon.name: Antidote Blade
weapon.description: every hit cures poison AND hurts bad guys

armor.name: Purifier Armor
armor.description: poison turns to water when it touches this

designs.victory_message: the venom queen is neutralized!! all the poison dried up!!
designs.defeat_message: the venom queen poisoned everything. including the air. including you.

boss.name: Shadow General
boss.description: he commands TEN THOUSAND shadow soldiers and hes the biggest shadow youve ever seen

weapon.name: Dawn Blade
weapon.description: it makes LIGHT when you swing it and shadows disappear

armor.name: Radiance Armor
armor.description: you GLOW. you are a walking flashlight of justice

designs.victory_message: the shadow general and his WHOLE army vanished in the light!!
designs.defeat_message: ten thousand shadows is too many shadows.

boss.name: Tower Dragon
boss.description: a dragon that lives in the TOWER and breathes DARK fire not regular fire

weapon.name: Tower Key Sword
weapon.description: the key to the top. also a sword. also AWESOME

armor.name: Gargoyle Armor
armor.description: stone armor from a gargoyle. heavy but NOTHING gets through

designs.victory_message: the tower dragon flew out the window!! the path to the top is OPEN!!
designs.defeat_message: the tower dragon dark-fired you. dark fire is WORSE than regular fire.

boss.name: THE DARK LORD
boss.description: THE boss. THE FINAL boss. THE LAST bad guy. hes been behind EVERYTHING and he has powers you havent even SEEN yet

weapon.name: Sword Of Light
weapon.description: THE ultimate weapon. it has the power of every hero who ever held it

armor.name: Armor Of Hope
armor.description: every person who ever believed in you made this armor stronger

designs.victory_message: THE DARK LORD IS DEFEATED!! LIGHT FILLS THE CASTLE!! YOU DID IT!! THE WHOLE GAME!! ALL OF IT!!
designs.defeat_message: the dark lord won. the darkness covers everything. but you can always try AGAIN.

overworld.name: Wizard School
overworld.description: its a school for WIZARDS and the bad wizards took over. they cast spells everywhere and turn things into frogs and its CHAOS.

levels.name: The Entrance Hall
levels.description: the doors open by MAGIC and the stairs MOVE. the paintings yell at you.
levels.theme: magical entrance, moving stairs, talking portraits

levels.name: Potions Class
levels.description: cauldrons everywhere and they bubble with WEIRD stuff. some of it explodes.
levels.theme: cauldrons, potion bottles, spell ingredients

levels.name: Library
levels.description: the books FLY around and some of them BITE. a whole library of angry books.
levels.theme: floating books, dusty shelves, reading ghosts

levels.name: Enchanted Gardens
levels.description: the plants are all MAGIC and they cast spells at you. flowers that shoot LIGHTNING.
levels.theme: magic plants, spell flowers, enchanted trees

levels.name: The Arena
levels.description: wizard duels happen here. now YOU have to duel the worst wizards.
levels.theme: dueling platforms, spell shields, magic circles

levels.name: The Headmasters Tower
levels.description: the evil headmaster is up here. he knows EVERY spell and he casts them ALL at once.
levels.theme: tower study, spell books, crystal ball, magic throne

boss.name: Hall Golem
boss.description: a suit of armor that came to LIFE from too much magic floating around

weapon.name: Wand Blade
weapon.description: its a wand AND a sword. swish and flick and STAB

armor.name: Robe Of Warding
armor.description: magic bounces right off

designs.victory_message: the hall golem fell apart!! just empty armor now!!
designs.defeat_message: the hall golem armor-crushed you. too many enchantments.

boss.name: Potion Master
boss.description: he throws EXPLODING potions at you. different colors do different bad things

weapon.name: Anti-Potion Rod
weapon.description: it makes potions do the OPPOSITE. healing potions hurt HIM

armor.name: Alchemist Coat
armor.description: splash-proof. no potion gets through

designs.victory_message: the potion master drank his own wrong potion!! hes a frog now!!
designs.defeat_message: the potion master splashed you with the WORST one. ribbit.

boss.name: Book Wyrm
boss.description: its a dragon made of BOOKS. it breathes PAPER at you. paper cuts EVERYWHERE

weapon.name: Bookmark Blade
weapon.description: slide it in a book and the book falls asleep

armor.name: Hardcover Shield
armor.description: the thickest book in the library

designs.victory_message: the book wyrm lost its pages!! just a cover now!!
designs.defeat_message: the book wyrm gave you SO many paper cuts. death by a thousand cuts.

boss.name: Garden Witch
boss.description: she grows EVERYTHING and everything she grows tries to eat you

weapon.name: Pruning Blade
weapon.description: it trims magic plants down to nothing

armor.name: Bark Shield
armor.description: living wood that blocks spells

designs.victory_message: the garden witch ran out of seeds!! the garden is peaceful!!
designs.defeat_message: the garden witch planted you. youre a garden decoration now.

boss.name: Duel Champion
boss.description: the BEST dueling wizard. undefeated for FIFTY duels

weapon.name: Spell Breaker
weapon.description: it shatters ANY spell. ANY one

armor.name: Duel Armor
armor.description: enchanted for wizard combat specifically

designs.victory_message: the duel champion bowed!! defeated fair and square!!
designs.defeat_message: the duel champion out-spelled you. better study harder.

boss.name: Evil Headmaster
boss.description: he knows LITERALLY every spell. he can cast SEVEN at the same time. SEVEN

weapon.name: Staff Of Ages
weapon.description: the original headmasters staff. it cancels the evil ones powers

armor.name: Archmage Robes
armor.description: the robes of the GREATEST wizard ever

designs.victory_message: THE EVIL HEADMASTER IS EXPELLED!! the school is saved!! MAGIC IS GOOD AGAIN!!
designs.defeat_message: the evil headmaster cast all seven spells. you needed eight shields.

overworld.name: Toy Box
overworld.description: you fell into a TOY BOX and all the toys are alive!! some of them are nice but MOST of them are NOT friendly at all.

levels.name: Block Town
levels.description: all the building blocks made a TOWN and the block people dont want visitors.
levels.theme: building blocks, block houses, geometric citizens

levels.name: Race Track
levels.description: the toy cars go SO fast and they try to RUN YOU OVER.
levels.theme: toy cars, race track, checkered flags

levels.name: Doll House
levels.description: the dolls live here and they have tea parties but the tea is POISON and they throw it at you.
levels.theme: tiny furniture, doll rooms, miniature everything

levels.name: Board Game Land
levels.description: youre INSIDE a board game and you have to play by the rules or the game ATTACKS you.
levels.theme: game board, dice, game pieces come alive

levels.name: Action Figure Arena
levels.description: the action figures fight each other ALL the time. now they want to fight YOU.
levels.theme: plastic warriors, kung fu poses, battle arena

levels.name: The Jack In The Box
levels.description: at the bottom of the toy box is the BIGGEST jack in the box EVER and when it pops WATCH OUT.
levels.theme: spring mechanism, circus colors, surprise chamber

boss.name: Block King
boss.description: hes a castle made of blocks and he rebuilds himself when you knock him down

weapon.name: Wrecking Ball
weapon.description: it smashes blocks into tiny pieces they CANT rebuild from

armor.name: Block Armor
armor.description: just blocks stuck together but its sturdy

designs.victory_message: the block king crumbled and STAYED crumbled this time!!
designs.defeat_message: the block king rebuilt himself bigger. and bigger. and bigger.

boss.name: Turbo Rex
boss.description: the FASTEST toy car. it goes SO fast it catches on FIRE

weapon.name: Tire Iron
weapon.description: it pops tires AND bonks heads

armor.name: Bumper Armor
armor.description: cars just bounce off you now

designs.victory_message: turbo rex ran out of gas!! pit stop FOREVER!!
designs.defeat_message: turbo rex ran you over at a thousand miles per hour. vroom.

boss.name: Queen Doll
boss.description: the FANCIEST doll and she commands all the other dolls and her tea is VERY poisonous

weapon.name: Pin Sword
weapon.description: a giant sewing pin. perfect doll-sized weapon

armor.name: Button Armor
armor.description: buttons sewn together. cute AND protective

designs.victory_message: the queen doll is just a regular doll now!! no more evil tea parties!!
designs.defeat_message: the queen doll invited you to a permanent tea party. FOREVER tea.

boss.name: Dungeon Master
boss.description: not the fun kind. the kind that CHEATS and makes the game impossible

weapon.name: Rule Book
weapon.description: hit a game piece with the rules and they HAVE to follow them

armor.name: Player Shield
armor.description: the shield of a registered player. you cant be cheated

designs.victory_message: the dungeon master rolled a critical FAIL!! game over for HIM!!
designs.defeat_message: the dungeon master changed the rules. you cant win a rigged game.

boss.name: Action Man
boss.description: the BIGGEST action figure. he has karate AND lasers AND a jetpack

weapon.name: Power Sword
weapon.description: the accessories are the best part of action figures

armor.name: Battle Armor
armor.description: full articulation AND protection

designs.victory_message: action man lost all his accessories!! hes just a plain figure now!!
designs.defeat_message: action man used all his accessories at once. COMBO.

boss.name: JACK
boss.description: the BIGGEST scariest jack in the box. when he pops out the WHOLE toy box shakes and hes TERRIFYING

weapon.name: Spring Blade
weapon.description: BOING it launches at enemies

armor.name: Box Armor
armor.description: the jack in the box box. hes not IN it anymore so you can use it

designs.victory_message: JACK IS BACK IN HIS BOX!! and this time hes STAYING there!!
designs.defeat_message: JACK popped out and you were NOT ready. surprise.

overworld.name: Swamp Of Yuck
overworld.description: its SO gross in here. everything is slimy and smelly and the monsters go BLURP and SPLAT and its DISGUSTING.

levels.name: Mud Flats
levels.description: mud EVERYWHERE. every step goes SQUELCH and mud monsters pop up.
levels.theme: flat mud, puddles, dead reeds

levels.name: Bog Of Stench
levels.description: it smells SO BAD you can almost SEE the smell. green clouds of YUCK.
levels.theme: bubbling bog, stench clouds, rotten logs

levels.name: Mushroom Marsh
levels.description: GIANT mushrooms everywhere and some of them squirt POISON if you bump them.
levels.theme: huge mushrooms, spore clouds, fungus ground

levels.name: Slime Pits
levels.description: pits full of SLIME and the slime is ALIVE and it wants to ABSORB you.
levels.theme: green slime, slime waterfalls, goo puddles

levels.name: Dead Forest
levels.description: all the trees are dead and zombies hang out here. ZOMBIE swamp things.
levels.theme: dead trees, zombie nests, fungus growths

levels.name: The Yuck Pit
levels.description: the GROSSEST place in the WHOLE swamp. the boss lives at the bottom and hes made of ALL the yuck.
levels.theme: deepest pit, concentrated gross, slime throne

boss.name: Mud Colossus
boss.description: a GIANT made of MUD. he throws mud balls the size of YOUR HEAD

weapon.name: Mud Rake
weapon.description: it scoops AND smashes

armor.name: Waterproof Cloak
armor.description: the mud just slides right off

designs.victory_message: the mud colossus splashed apart!! just a big puddle now!!
designs.defeat_message: the mud colossus buried you in mud. glub glub.

boss.name: Stench Lord
boss.description: he smells SO BAD that being near him is an ATTACK. your eyes water

weapon.name: Fresh Air Blade
weapon.description: it pushes the stink AWAY. blessed fresh air

armor.name: Gas Mask Armor
armor.description: you cant smell ANYTHING. thank goodness

designs.victory_message: the stench lord dried out!! he doesnt smell anymore!! well less!!
designs.defeat_message: the stench lord out-grossed you. SO much stench.

boss.name: Mushroom King
boss.description: hes the BIGGEST mushroom and he controls all the spores and they make you dizzy

weapon.name: Spore Cutter
weapon.description: it cuts mushrooms AND clears the air

armor.name: Mycelium Armor
armor.description: the mushrooms think youre ONE OF THEM

designs.victory_message: the mushroom king POPPED!! what a mess but hes done!!
designs.defeat_message: the mushroom king spored you. youre a mushroom person now.

boss.name: Mega Slime
boss.description: its ALL the slimes combined into ONE. its as big as a HOUSE and its HUNGRY

weapon.name: Drying Blade
weapon.description: it dries up slime on contact. PSSHH gone

armor.name: Teflon Armor
armor.description: nothing sticks. NOTHING. the slimes just slide off

designs.victory_message: the mega slime evaporated!! just a stain on the floor!!
designs.defeat_message: the mega slime absorbed you. youre part of the slime now.

boss.name: Swamp Lich
boss.description: it controls ALL the zombies AND the dead trees. its been dead for YEARS but it wont stay down

weapon.name: Holy Blade
