weapon.description: the undead HATE this sword. it glows when they get close

armor.name: Life Armor
armor.description: being alive is your best defense against the undead

designs.victory_message: the swamp lich finally died for REAL!! rest in peace FINALLY!!
designs.defeat_message: the swamp lich made you undead too. but not the cool kind.

boss.name: THE YUCK
boss.description: its not even a monster its just... YUCK. all the grossness of the whole swamp made into one THING

weapon.name: Clean Blade
weapon.description: it SANITIZES. the yuck HATES clean things

armor.name: Hazmat Supreme
armor.description: the ultimate protection from gross stuff

designs.victory_message: THE YUCK IS CLEANED UP!! the swamp actually smells OKAY now!! relatively!!
designs.defeat_message: the yuck yucked you. thats not even a word but thats what happened.

overworld.name: Ninja Village
overworld.description: theres NINJAS everywhere. they hide in shadows and jump out and go HI-YA!! you gotta be sneaky too but theyre REALLY good at being sneaky.

levels.name: Training Grounds
levels.description: this is where ninjas PRACTICE. theres training dummies but some arent dummies.
levels.theme: dojo, training posts, bamboo forest

levels.name: Shadow Market
levels.description: the ninjas buy their weapons here. in the DARK. everything is a secret.
levels.theme: dark stalls, weapon displays, hooded figures

levels.name: Bamboo Maze
levels.description: the bamboo grows SO thick you cant see and ninjas hide behind EVERY stalk.
levels.theme: dense bamboo, narrow paths, hidden ninjas

levels.name: Temple Rooftops
levels.description: jumping from roof to roof and the ninjas are FASTER than you up here.
levels.theme: temple roofs, paper lanterns, jumping paths

levels.name: The Scroll Chamber
levels.description: every forbidden ninja technique is written on scrolls in here and the guards know ALL of them.
levels.theme: scroll racks, reading rooms, ink paintings

levels.name: Shadow Master Dojo
levels.description: the MASTER ninja lives here. you cant even SEE him until he STRIKES.
levels.theme: dark dojo, shadow training, mirror walls

boss.name: Sensei Bronze
boss.description: the basic training master. fast hands and LOTS of throwing stars

weapon.name: Training Blade
weapon.description: not sharp but FAST. speed beats sharpness

armor.name: Training Gi
armor.description: light and lets you move FAST

designs.victory_message: sensei bronze bowed!! you passed the first test!!
designs.defeat_message: sensei bronze was too fast. couldnt even see the hit coming.

boss.name: Shadow Broker
boss.description: she sells SECRETS and she knows YOURS. she knows where youll move before YOU do

weapon.name: Truth Blade
weapon.description: she cant predict THIS sword because it moves randomly

armor.name: Shadow Cloak
armor.description: you blend into the shadows too now

designs.victory_message: the shadow broker lost her network!! no more secrets!!
designs.defeat_message: the shadow broker sold your location. ambush.

boss.name: Bamboo Phantom
boss.description: it IS the bamboo. the WHOLE bamboo forest is ONE ninja

weapon.name: Wind Cutter
weapon.description: cuts bamboo AND air AND bad guys

armor.name: Leaf Armor
armor.description: light as leaves but tough as bark

designs.victory_message: the bamboo phantom split into regular bamboo!! just plants now!!
designs.defeat_message: the bamboo phantom was everywhere at once. you cant fight a forest.

boss.name: Roof Runner
boss.description: the FASTEST ninja on the rooftops. she jumps gaps that are IMPOSSIBLE

weapon.name: Grapple Blade
weapon.description: it hooks onto roofs so YOU can jump the gaps too

armor.name: Roof Tile Armor
armor.description: tiles from the temple. sacred AND strong

designs.victory_message: the roof runner fell off!! she landed on a haystack so shes ok but she lost!!
designs.defeat_message: the roof runner pushed you off the roof. the ground is far away.

boss.name: Scroll Guardian
boss.description: it knows EVERY technique on EVERY scroll and it uses them ALL

weapon.name: Eraser Blade
weapon.description: it ERASES the techniques so they cant be used

armor.name: Sealed Armor
armor.description: the scrolls techniques bounce right off

designs.victory_message: the scroll guardian ran out of techniques!! every scroll is blank now!!
designs.defeat_message: the scroll guardian used the forbidden technique. you dont want to know what it does.

boss.name: SHADOW MASTER
boss.description: you literally CANNOT see him. he moves through shadows like water and strikes from NOWHERE

weapon.name: Light Katana
weapon.description: it illuminates EVERYTHING. no more shadows for him to hide in

armor.name: Sun Armor
armor.description: you GLOW so bright shadows cant exist near you

designs.victory_message: THE SHADOW MASTER IS REVEALED!! turns out hes really small without all the shadows!!
designs.defeat_message: the shadow master struck from everywhere at once. you never saw it.

overworld.name: Junkyard World
overworld.description: its a HUGE junkyard and all the junk is alive and angry about being thrown away. crushed cars and old TVs and everything is GRUMPY.

levels.name: Scrap Heaps
levels.description: piles and PILES of scrap metal. they shift and fall and things live inside.
levels.theme: metal piles, rust, scattered parts

levels.name: Appliance Alley
levels.description: old fridges and ovens and they open their doors like MOUTHS and try to eat you.
levels.theme: broken appliances, power cables, sparks

levels.name: Car Crusher
levels.description: the crusher is RUNNING and cars get smashed and some of the smashed cars fight back.
levels.theme: car compactor, crushed metal, hydraulic press

levels.name: Toxic Dump
levels.description: the gross part of the junkyard. chemicals leaking and glowing green puddles.
levels.theme: chemical barrels, green goo, hazard signs

levels.name: Robot Graveyard
levels.description: broken robots that got thrown away but some of them put themselves BACK together.
levels.theme: robot parts, half-built machines, sparking wires

levels.name: The Compactor
levels.description: the MAIN machine that crushes EVERYTHING. its alive and its the boss and its ENORMOUS.
levels.theme: massive machine, crushing walls, conveyor belt

boss.name: Scrap Titan
boss.description: a HUGE thing made of all the scrap smashed together. every piece is angry

weapon.name: Pipe Wrench
weapon.description: hits hard AND can fix stuff

armor.name: Hubcap Shield
armor.description: a car hubcap. round and durable

designs.victory_message: the scrap titan fell to pieces!! and the pieces are too small to fight!!
designs.defeat_message: the scrap titan piled more scrap on itself. it got bigger. you didnt.

boss.name: Fridge Horror
boss.description: a fridge that ate all the OTHER appliances and now its HUGE and opens its door at you

weapon.name: Magnet Blade
weapon.description: it pulls metal parts OFF the monsters

armor.name: Rubber Suit
armor.description: no electricity can get you

designs.victory_message: the fridge horror unplugged!! its just a fridge again!!
designs.defeat_message: the fridge horror ate you. youre inside the fridge now. its dark and cold.

boss.name: Crusher King
boss.description: a car that went through the crusher and came out ANGRY and FLAT and wants REVENGE

weapon.name: Jack Handle
weapon.description: it lifts heavy things AND smashes them

armor.name: Tire Armor
armor.description: bouncy and protective

designs.victory_message: the crusher king got crushed AGAIN!! flat as a pancake!!
designs.defeat_message: the crusher king crushed you. now youre flat too.

boss.name: Toxic Blob
boss.description: its made of ALL the chemicals mixed together. whatever you do dont let it TOUCH you

weapon.name: Neutralizer Rod
weapon.description: it turns toxic stuff into water. science!!

armor.name: Hazmat Suit
armor.description: total protection from anything gross or toxic

designs.victory_message: the toxic blob is neutralized!! just harmless water now!!
designs.defeat_message: the toxic blob touched you. itchy. VERY itchy.

boss.name: Frankenbot
boss.description: it built ITSELF from all the thrown-away robots. its got six arms and three heads

weapon.name: EMP Staff
weapon.description: one zap and robots go to sleep

armor.name: Salvage Armor
armor.description: built from the GOOD robot parts

designs.victory_message: frankenbot powered down!! all the parts fell off!!
designs.defeat_message: frankenbot added YOUR stuff to itself. it got bigger. you got naked.

boss.name: THE COMPACTOR
boss.description: the MAIN machine. it crushes EVERYTHING that goes in. cars, robots, heroes, EVERYTHING. and its ALIVE

weapon.name: Override Key
weapon.description: the emergency shutdown key. also works as a sword

armor.name: Titan Plate
armor.description: the strongest junk armor EVER

designs.victory_message: THE COMPACTOR IS OFF!! the junkyard is quiet for the first time EVER!!
designs.defeat_message: the compactor crushed you into a cube. a very small cube.

overworld.name: Volcano Fortress
overworld.description: theres a fortress INSIDE a volcano and the fire army lives there. theyre trained soldiers who are also ON FIRE.

levels.name: The Gates
levels.description: the fortress gates are HUGE and guarded by fire knights who never sleep.
levels.theme: fortress entrance, fire guards, lava moat

levels.name: Fire Barracks
levels.description: where the fire soldiers live. THOUSANDS of them. training and fighting and burning stuff.
levels.theme: bunks, weapon racks, training fires

levels.name: The Armory
levels.description: fire weapons EVERYWHERE. fire swords fire shields fire everything.
levels.theme: weapon walls, fire forges, molten metal

levels.name: Magma Forge
levels.description: where they MAKE the fire weapons. the forge master is in here and hes HUGE.
levels.theme: massive forge, lava channels, anvils

levels.name: War Room
levels.description: the fire generals plan their attacks here. maps of EVERYWHERE.
levels.theme: war table, battle plans, crystal balls

levels.name: The Volcano Heart
levels.description: the CORE of the volcano. the fire emperor sits on a throne of PURE FLAME.
levels.theme: volcano core, magma throne, eternal fire

boss.name: Gate Captain
boss.description: he holds the keys to the fortress and hes been guarding for a HUNDRED years

weapon.name: Ice Pick
weapon.description: cold weapons against hot enemies. basic strategy

armor.name: Fireproof Plate
armor.description: the fire army HATES that this exists

designs.victory_message: the gates are OPEN!! the fortress is vulnerable!!
designs.defeat_message: the gate captain locked you out. and in. somehow both.

boss.name: War Chief
boss.description: she trains ALL the soldiers and she fights BETTER than all of them combined

weapon.name: Frost Axe
weapon.description: every hit freezes the fire. PSSHH steam

armor.name: Cooling Armor
armor.description: stays cold no matter how hot it gets

designs.victory_message: the war chief surrendered!! her soldiers put their fires out!!
designs.defeat_message: the war chief called ALL her soldiers. thats a lot of fire.

boss.name: Armory Golem
boss.description: its made of ALL the weapons in the armory. swords and shields and spears ALL at once

weapon.name: Disarm Rod
weapon.description: it knocks weapons RIGHT out of hands. and golems

armor.name: Weapon Ward
armor.description: weapons break when they hit this armor

designs.victory_message: the armory golem dropped all its weapons!! just an empty suit now!!
designs.defeat_message: the armory golem had too many weapons. you had one. math.

boss.name: Forge Master
boss.description: he hammers things in LAVA and he wants to hammer YOU

weapon.name: Quench Blade
weapon.description: it quenches ANY forge fire. the forge master HATES it

armor.name: Forge-Proof Armor
armor.description: literally forged in the forge. the forge cant hurt what it made

designs.victory_message: the forge master dropped his hammer!! the forge is cooling down!!
designs.defeat_message: the forge master forged you into a sword. wait thats not right. he just hit you really hard.

boss.name: Fire General
boss.description: he planned the ENTIRE fire army invasion and hes got a plan for YOU too

weapon.name: Chaos Blade
weapon.description: it makes plans FAIL. the general cant plan against chaos

armor.name: Commanders Armor
armor.description: outranks everyone in the fortress

designs.victory_message: the fire general lost his plans!! no plan survives contact with YOU!!
designs.defeat_message: the fire generals plan worked. it was a really good plan.

boss.name: FIRE EMPEROR
boss.description: the RULER of ALL fire. he IS the volcano. if he gets mad the whole thing ERUPTS

weapon.name: Absolute Zero Blade
weapon.description: the COLDEST weapon ever. it can freeze the SUN

armor.name: Volcano Heart Armor
armor.description: made from the core of a volcano. fire proof FOREVER

designs.victory_message: THE FIRE EMPEROR IS EXTINGUISHED!! the volcano is dormant!! the fire army is just steam!!
designs.defeat_message: the fire emperor erupted. the whole volcano erupted. everything erupted.

overworld.name: Cloud Kingdom
overworld.description: way WAY up in the clouds theres a whole kingdom. giants live here and everything is ENORMOUS. the cups are as big as bathtubs.

levels.name: Beanstalk Top
levels.description: you climbed a beanstalk and NOW youre in giant territory. everything is SO BIG.
levels.theme: massive beanstalk, cloud ground, giant footprints

levels.name: Giant Garden
levels.description: the giants garden. each flower is as tall as a TREE. the bees are as big as DOGS.
levels.theme: enormous flowers, giant vegetables, huge insects

levels.name: Kitchen Of Doom
levels.description: the giants KITCHEN. the pots could fit a swimming pool. the knives are as big as surfboards.
levels.theme: massive kitchen, enormous utensils, boiling cauldrons

levels.name: Treasure Vault
levels.description: the giants keep ALL their treasure here. gold coins as big as TABLES.
levels.theme: massive gold piles, enormous gems, vault doors

levels.name: Throne Room
levels.description: the giant kings throne room. the ceiling is SO high you cant even see it.
levels.theme: enormous throne, pillar hall, giant tapestries

levels.name: Cloud Peak
levels.description: above EVERYTHING. the giant king at the very top of the kingdom. looking down at the WHOLE world.
levels.theme: cloud summit, wind throne, sky view

boss.name: Garden Giant
boss.description: hes the smallest giant which means hes only as big as a HOUSE

weapon.name: Giant Needle
weapon.description: a sewing needle the size of a sword. perfect

armor.name: Thimble Helm
armor.description: a thimble that fits perfectly as a helmet

designs.victory_message: the garden giant sat down!! he gave up!! the beanstalk is safe!!
designs.defeat_message: the garden giant stepped on you. he didnt even feel it.

boss.name: Flower Titan
boss.description: a GIANT living flower. it shoots pollen that makes you sneeze so hard you fall down

weapon.name: Pruning Shears
weapon.description: giant-sized garden tools. cuts through ANYTHING

armor.name: Petal Armor
armor.description: flower petals bigger than shields

designs.victory_message: the flower titan wilted!! no more killer pollen!!
designs.defeat_message: the flower titan sneezed you off the cloud. achoo indeed.

boss.name: Chef Giant
boss.description: she thinks youre an INGREDIENT. she keeps trying to put you in the SOUP

weapon.name: Fork Trident
weapon.description: a fork from the giant table. three prongs of POWER

armor.name: Pot Lid Shield
armor.description: a pot lid the perfect size for you

designs.victory_message: the chef giant found a COOKBOOK and realized youre NOT food!!
designs.defeat_message: the chef giant put you in the soup. its actually warm and cozy but youre soup now.

boss.name: Gold Dragon
boss.description: a dragon that lives IN the treasure pile. covered in gold coins

weapon.name: Diamond Sword
weapon.description: the hardest gem. cuts through gold AND dragons

armor.name: Mithril Armor
armor.description: lighter than gold but WAY stronger

designs.victory_message: the gold dragon left to find MORE treasure somewhere else!!
designs.defeat_message: the gold dragon buried you in coins. rich but crushed.

boss.name: Giant Prince
boss.description: the kings SON. hes young but hes BIG and he thinks fighting small people is a GAME

weapon.name: Growing Sword
weapon.description: it gets bigger when you need it to. giant-sized hits

armor.name: Giant Slayer Armor
armor.description: makes you strong enough to fight giants

designs.victory_message: the giant prince ran to tell his DAD. uh oh. but you won THIS fight!!
designs.defeat_message: the giant prince picked you up and wouldnt let go. like a toy.

boss.name: GIANT KING
boss.description: the BIGGEST giant. his footsteps cause EARTHQUAKES below. his voice is THUNDER

weapon.name: Sky Cleaver
weapon.description: the legendary giant-slaying sword. it can cut ANYTHING no matter how big

armor.name: Cloud Plate
armor.description: armor made of hardened clouds. light as air strong as diamond

designs.victory_message: THE GIANT KING BOWED TO YOU!! the smallest hero beat the biggest king!! the clouds are peaceful!!
designs.defeat_message: the giant king flicked you. just one finger. thats all it took.

overworld.name: Time Machine
overworld.description: you got a TIME MACHINE and you go to different times. theres bad guys in EVERY time period and you gotta beat them ALL.

levels.name: Dinosaur Times
levels.description: youre back when DINOSAURS were alive and theyre even scarier in their OWN time.
levels.theme: prehistoric jungle, real dinosaurs, volcanic ash

levels.name: Knight Times
levels.description: medieval stuff. castles and knights and dragons. everyone talks funny.
levels.theme: castle walls, jousting field, medieval town

levels.name: Pirate Times
levels.description: the golden age of PIRATES. even MORE pirates than pirate ocean.
levels.theme: pirate ships, tropical port, treasure maps

levels.name: Future Times
levels.description: the FUTURE. everything is chrome and the robots havent taken over YET but theyre thinking about it.
levels.theme: chrome buildings, hover cars, robot citizens

levels.name: Time Storm
levels.description: all the times are getting MIXED UP. dinosaurs and robots and pirates all at ONCE.
levels.theme: time rifts, mixed eras, reality cracks

levels.name: The End Of Time
levels.description: the LAST place. beyond all time. the time lord lives here and he wants to ERASE everything.
levels.theme: void space, time crystals, clock gears, nothingness

boss.name: Time Rex
boss.description: a t-rex that learned to travel through time. hes in EVERY era being a problem

weapon.name: Chrono Spear
weapon.description: hits things in the PAST so theyre already hurt in the present

armor.name: Cave Armor
armor.description: primitive but TOUGH

designs.victory_message: the time rex went back to his own time!! STAY there!!
designs.defeat_message: the time rex ate you in EVERY time period simultaneously. ow times infinity.

boss.name: Dark Knight
boss.description: not the batman kind. the evil armored kind with a HUGE lance

weapon.name: Excalibur
weapon.description: THE legendary sword. only the TRUE hero can pull it out

armor.name: Plate Mail
armor.description: the BEST medieval armor. clanky but invincible

designs.victory_message: the dark knight surrendered his lance!! chivalry wins!!
designs.defeat_message: the dark knight jousted you right off the timeline.

boss.name: Time Pirate
boss.description: a pirate who steals treasure from EVERY time period. the richest pirate EVER

weapon.name: Temporal Cutlass
weapon.description: it cuts through time AND pirates

armor.name: Time Lock Armor
armor.description: youre locked to the present so time attacks dont work

designs.victory_message: the time pirate lost his time ship!! hes stuck in one era now!!
designs.defeat_message: the time pirate sent you to the boring part of history. nothing happens there.

boss.name: Mecha Lord
boss.description: a robot from SO far in the future it has weapons that dont even exist yet

weapon.name: Anti-Matter Blade
weapon.description: it cancels out future tech. like a cheat code for the future

armor.name: Quantum Armor
armor.description: exists in all timelines so it blocks EVERYTHING

designs.victory_message: the mecha lord powered down!! future saved from its own robots!!
designs.defeat_message: the mecha lord used a weapon from the year infinity. you didnt stand a chance.

boss.name: Time Storm
boss.description: its not even a monster its a STORM of all time happening at ONCE

weapon.name: Anchor Of Reality
weapon.description: it holds time STILL so the storm cant blow you around

armor.name: Reality Armor
armor.description: you stay REAL no matter how weird time gets

designs.victory_message: the time storm calmed down!! all the eras went back where they belong!!
designs.defeat_message: the time storm sent you to every era at once. thats too many eras.

boss.name: THE TIME LORD
boss.description: he controls ALL of time and he wants to ERASE everything. the whole universe. the whole GAME

weapon.name: Infinity Blade
weapon.description: hits with the power of EVERY moment in time. ALL of them

armor.name: Eternity Armor
armor.description: protects you from being ERASED from existence

designs.victory_message: THE TIME LORD IS FROZEN IN HIS OWN TIME!! EVERYTHING IS SAVED!! ALL THE TIMES!! THE WHOLE GAME!! YOU DID IT!!
designs.defeat_message: the time lord erased you from time. you never existed. wait then who played the game.

and they have REALLY scary bad guys in them
and you gotta fight ALL of them
and some of them are SO hard you wont even believe it
OK LETS GO!! press the button!!
strings.campaign_conquered: {name} is DONE!! you beat ALL the bad guys!!
